name: Waterfall chart
oneLiner: a glass bar rises from a lit floor with its value counting, then each change steps off the last level with a dashed link, gains growing up in green and losses hanging down in grey, and the total bar drops from above in the accent, lands with a squash and a floor splash, and counts up to the end value while the camera leans in
say: when the speaker walks from a start number to an end number through what added and what took away ('we started at 120, gained 64, lost 22, and ended at 200'): cut in on the start, the total bar lands on the word that names the result
